# SCADABLE 2026 · Apache-2.0
# Selected by sdkconfig.4mb overlay. For 8 MiB chips see the companion
# partitions_8mb.csv (selected by sdkconfig.8mb overlay).
# Strategy: same as the 8 MiB variant — provisioning firmware lives in
# `factory` permanently; customer firmware is OTA'd into ota_0 / ota_1.
# Bootloader prefers OTA but falls back to factory on invalid slots
# giving us the recovery-app pattern (any failure boots back into
# provisioning
# re-flashing).
# Sizes (every byte accounted for):
#   nvs       24 KiB    wifi creds + scadable_certs + libscadable state
#   phy_init  4 KiB     radio calibration data (IDF default location)
#   otadata   8 KiB     two sectors
#   factory   1.25 MiB  provisioning firmware (~600 KiB today
#   ota_0     1.25 MiB  customer firmware slot A
#   ota_1     1.25 MiB  customer firmware slot B
# Total: 3.875 MiB used of a 4 MiB chip (128 KiB end-of-flash slack
# left as a buffer for nvs growth or coredump partition later). Tight
# but standard: most ESP32 dev boards in the wild are 4 MiB and this
# is the layout esptool's default 4MB recipe targets.
# All offsets are sector-aligned (multiples of 0x1000). otadata sits
# at 0x10000 right after nvs+phy_init
